messages:
tara (oncall): apiserver 503s in eu-west1 region since ~1712349800. GPU onboarding jobs are piling up in provisioner queue. seeing a bunch of `etcdserver: store/index: compacted` lines in etcd logs and high wal sync latency.
aj (infra): copying logs, can you paste the etcd compaction timestamps and apiserver errors? any correlation with node attach events?
tara (oncall): logs: 
```
 2024-04-02T12:34:03.123Z etcdserver: compaction took 420ms, paused writes
 2024-04-02T12:34:04.600Z apiserver: http: TLS handshake error from 10.0.12.34: remote error: tls: bad certificate
 2024-04-02T12:34:05.001Z apiserver: response 503 GET /apis/core/v1/namespaces/default/pods
 2024-04-02T12:34:06.500Z provisioner: attach request queued for instance-rtx-02
 ```
leo (eng-sre): that 420ms compaction is not huge on its own, but if there's WAL fsync hotspots it amplifies. what's IO wait on etcd hosts?
maria (platform): metrics show iowait spikes on etcd nodes at 12:34, nvme queue depth jumps. also apiserver pod CPU spiking ~2x during same window.
aj (infra): rolling to check disk saturation: `ssh etcd-1 -- iostat -x 1 5` and `sar -b`. also checking kube-proxy conn count.
leo (eng-sre): temp mitigation: scale apiserver replicas to 5 in eu-west1 to even out client connections and reduce per-pod fd pressure. also reduce provisioner burst to avoid thundering attach.
tara (oncall): can we patch provisioner config quickly? current max_concurrent_attaches=100 -> suggest 30.
aj (infra): I can push a canary: `/api/v1/namespaces/infra/configmaps/provisioner-config` patch with `max_concurrent_attaches: 30` and `backoff_ms: 250` now. doing it.
leo (eng-sre): also, add temporary apiserver fallback policy to route lightweight read-only traffic to eu-central1 where etcd is healthy. set smart routing rule for /metrics and /healthz to eu-central1 for 5m.
maria (platform): creating a RoutePolicy draft. NOTE: need to ensure no zk/lock dependents for controllers. controller-manager has some leader election chatter but still OK.
tara (oncall): controller-manager logs show a couple of election timeouts ~12:34:10 but leader remained stable. not the primary cause but adds load.
leo (eng-sre): long term: investigate compaction schedule vs workload. maybe switch to incremental compaction windows and tune commit batch sizes. also consider moving etcd WAL to dedicated throughput-optimized disk or enable writeback cache tuning.
aj (infra): opening infra ticket INF-4821 to repro under load and test WAL layout and iops. tagging storage and provisioning teams.
maria (platform): we're also seeing a pattern where GPU onboarding creates many small pod creations in a burst which hotspots the k/vspace. adding a small jitter to onboarding controller to smooth arrivals would help.
tara (oncall): outcome: applied provisioner throttle canary; scaled apiserver replicas + routing rule applied. immediate error rate dropped ~65% in first 90s. keeping an eye. will follow up with postmortem if stable. :thumbsup:
leo (eng-sre): thanks, folks. next steps: 1) repro on staging with synthetic onboarding burst 2) storage perf tests for etcd WAL 3) apply jitter in provisioner and controller-manager rollout 4) postmortem + cost impact calc for increased apiserver replicas and potential dedicated etcd disks.
js-bot: incident created: INC-2024-1173 (severity: medium) assigned to eng-sre.
tara (oncall): leaving notes in incident channel and moving to monitor; ping me if regressions appear.
